primitives.name: Scope Control Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: Produce narrowly.** Pull a complete copy of the relevant date range so nothing is lost or later alleged to have been destroyed — then hand your attorney only what is responsive.
primitives.assumptions: All relevant data must be captured before selective disclosure; scope is defined by temporal and categorical constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E_{full} ⊄ E_{responsive}, legal liability increases due to incomplete disclosure.

layer2.mapping: The principle mirrors Bayesian marginalization where full posterior is preserved but only relevant marginal is produced.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of complete data capture vs. responsive subset delivery.

primitives.name: Backup Integrity Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Verify it landed.** The backup is a GUID-named folder in one of: ``` %USERPROFILE%\Apple\MobileSync\Backup\ (Apple Devices / Store build) %APPDATA%\Apple Computer\MobileSync\Backup\ (classic iTunes) ``` Tell me when it's there and I'll confirm the path and contents.
primitives.assumptions: Backup location is deterministic and accessible; verification requires path existence and content validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If V = false, system failure occurs due to missing or corrupted backup.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of backup validation logic derived from file system consistency checks and cryptographic hash comparison.
layer2.telemetry: Path existence and checksum match of backup directory contents.

primitives.name: Data Segregation by Category
primitives.verbatim_quote: These are two different sets and they belong in two different folders.
primitives.assumptions: Each data set corresponds to distinct legal or operational categories requiring independent handling.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Cross-contamination occurs if D_{primary} ∩ D_{secondary} ≠ ∅ without explicit separation.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to category theory partitions where each set maps uniquely into its own category.
layer2.telemetry: Folder structure compliance and absence of cross-set file inclusion.

Failure modes arise from violating these dualities—e.g., producing incomplete sets leads to legal liability, skipping verification risks data corruption, mixing categories undermines evidentiary purity.
